action.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".arguments.path // empty"); if [[ "$FILE" == *"app-config/psychometric-procedure.yaml"* ]]; then CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".arguments.text // .arguments.newStr // empty"); if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "(i_cvi_threshold|kappa_star_threshold|definitional_correspondence_threshold|distinctiveness_threshold|wto_threshold|stability_threshold|boot_iterations|max_revision_rounds|max_iterations): [0-9]"; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"You are attempting to set a psychometric threshold value in app-config/psychometric-procedure.yaml. Per project rules (00-project-rules.md), threshold values must be owner decisions, not AI-generated estimates. If the owner has decided this value, proceed. Otherwise, leave as null and ask the owner.\"}}" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'
